passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My name is Mina, and I am thirteen years old.
phrases.ko: 내 이름은 미나이고, 나는 열세 살이에요.
phrases.py: wǒ jiào mǐ nà， wǒ shí sān suì。

phrases.en: I am a student in the sixth grade.
phrases.py: wǒ shì liù nián jí de xué shēng。

phrases.en: I live in a small house with my family.
phrases.ko: 나는 가족과 함께 작은 집에 살아요.
phrases.zh: 我和家人住在一所小房子里。
phrases.py: wǒ hé jiā rén zhù zài yī suǒ xiǎo fáng zi lǐ。

phrases.en: I have a little sister, and she is eleven years old.
phrases.ko: 나에게는 여동생이 있고, 동생은 열한 살이에요.
phrases.zh: 我有一个妹妹，她十一岁。
phrases.py: wǒ yǒu yí gè mèi mèi， tā shí yī suì。

phrases.en: My little sister is in the fourth grade, and we play every day.
phrases.zh: 我的妹妹上四年级，我们每天一起玩。
phrases.py: wǒ de mèi mèi shàng sì nián jí， wǒ men měi tiān yì qǐ wán。

phrases.en: I like English, and I also like soccer.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢英语，也喜欢足球。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān yīng yǔ， yě xǐ huān zú qiú。

phrases.en: My hobby is drawing pictures of animals and people.
phrases.ko: 나의 취미는 동물과 사람 그림을 그리는 거예요.
phrases.zh: 我的爱好是画动物和人。
phrases.py: wǒ de ài hào shì huà dòng wù hé rén。

phrases.en: I often draw a picture of my family.
phrases.py: wǒ cháng cháng huà wǒ men yī jiā rén。

phrases.en: After school, I play soccer with my friends.
phrases.ko: 방과 후에 나는 친구들과 축구를 해요.
phrases.zh: 放学以后，我和朋友们踢足球。
phrases.py: fàng xué yǐ hòu， wǒ hé péng yǒu men tī zú qiú。

phrases.en: In the evening, I do my homework at home.
phrases.py: bàng wǎn wǒ zài jiā zuò zuò yè。

phrases.en: At night, I read a book with my sister.
phrases.ko: 나는 밤에 여동생과 함께 책을 읽어요.
phrases.zh: 晚上我和妹妹一起看书。
phrases.py: wǎn shàng wǒ hé mèi mèi yì qǐ kàn shū。

phrases.en: I love my family very much, and they love me too.
phrases.ko: 나는 가족을 매우 사랑하고, 가족도 나를 사랑해요.
phrases.zh: 我很爱我的家人，他们也很爱我。
phrases.py: wǒ hěn ài wǒ de jiā rén， tā men yě hěn ài wǒ。

full_passage_spoken: My name is Mina, and I am thirteen years old. I am a student in the sixth grade. I live in a small house with my family. I have a little sister, and she is eleven years old. My little sister is in the fourth grade, and we play every day. I like English, and I also like soccer. My hobby is drawing pictures of animals and people. I often draw a picture of my family. After school, I play soccer with my friends. In the evening, I do my homework at home. At night, I read a book with my sister. I love my family very much, and they love me too.
full_passage_zh: 我叫米娜，我十三岁。我是六年级的学生。我和家人住在一所小房子里。我有一个妹妹，她十一岁。我的妹妹上四年级，我们每天一起玩。我喜欢英语，也喜欢足球。我的爱好是画动物和人。我常常画我们一家人。放学以后，我和朋友们踢足球。傍晚我在家做作业。晚上我和妹妹一起看书。我很爱我的家人，他们也很爱我。
